source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: Five adds: Campbell County's A.J. Jolly (closed for the 2026 season, caveated), Crittenden County's Riverview RV Park at Dam 50, Shelby County's Lake Shelby, Barbourville's Thompson RV Park and Hancock County's Vastwood Park. The listing also shows Mammoth Cave's Houchin Ferry absent (federal gap: RIDB lists it at 0,0, so the RIDB gap pull dropped it), and ~30 unmatched private campgrounds. (Corrected 2026-09-28: Hillman Ferry was wrongly logged as missing - it is id 684; the Good Sam pin is its Grand Rivers mailing address, 7.5 km off.)
